title: Borderlands: Legendary Collection
synopsis: Borderlands, Borderlands 2, and The Pre-Sequel with their add-ons — retained as 2K’s Nintendo Switch package.

catalog.developer: Gearbox Software · Nintendo Switch port by Turn Me Up Games
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card with download code · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case, with download code

curatorNotes:
Borderlands: Legendary Collection brings Gearbox Software’s first three Borderlands games to Nintendo Switch: Borderlands Game of the Year Edition, Borderlands 2, and Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel, each with its downloadable content.

2K released it on May 29, 2020. The games run on a single console with split-screen co-op in docked play.

The filing joins the Borderlands lineage already on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is 2K’s retail edition of Borderlands: Legendary Collection for Nintendo Switch.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. The card holds only Borderlands Game of the Year Edition; Borderlands 2 and The Pre-Sequel are delivered by a download code in the package, so two of the three games depend on the Nintendo eShop and are not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Borderlands released in 2009, Borderlands 2 in 2012, and The Pre-Sequel in 2014. The Nintendo Switch collection (HAC-P-AVSFA) released May 29, 2020.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by 2K, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
